mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_product (tenant_id, product_code, product_name, protocol, status, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{protocol}, #{status}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_code, product_name, protocol, status, description, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_product WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT id, tenant_id, product_code, product_name, protocol, status, description, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_product WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC
